
            <div class="postcontent">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<section id="mp-md" style="-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-autospace: normal; text-align: left; padding: 1em; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.75; word-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在自动化报表生成与数据处理场景中，数值的展示方式直接影响文档的可读性与专业性。千分位分隔、货币符号、百分比显示、日期格式化等效果，均通过 Excel 的数字格式机制实现。本文将介绍如何通过 Python 代码精确控制 Excel 单元格的数字显示格式，示例基于 Free Spire.XLS for Python 免费库实现。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">一、环境准备</span></h2>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1.1 库安装</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">通过 pip 安装免费版本：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-bash" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">pip install spire.xls.free
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">安装完成后，在 Python 脚本中导入相关模块即可使用：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
</code></pre>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1.2 核心概念</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Excel 的数字格式作用于</span><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">数值型数据</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，仅改变显示外观，不改变单元格的实际存储值。设置格式涉及两个核心属性：</span></p>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 8px 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">NumberValue</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：写入单元格的原始数值（必须为数值类型）</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">NumberFormat</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：格式代码字符串，定义数值的显示规则</span></li>
</ul>
<blockquote style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 16px 20px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); background: rgba(43, 174, 133, 0.05); border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; word-break: break-all; margin: 8px 0 0; color: rgba(102, 102, 102, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">注意：若通过 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Text</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 属性写入数字字符串，数字格式将不会生效。必须使用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">NumberValue</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 赋值，才能保证格式正确应用。</span></p>
</blockquote>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">二、常用数字格式分类与代码</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Excel 数字格式代码遵循四段式结构：</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">正数格式;负数格式;零值格式;文本格式</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，各段用分号分隔。实际使用中可根据需求省略部分段落。以下分类介绍高频场景。</span></p>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2.1 常规数值与小数位数</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">控制小数点后的保留位数，以及是否显示千分位分隔符。</span></p>

<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">代码示例：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"D2"</span>].NumberValue = <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1234567.89</span>
sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"D2"</span>].NumberFormat = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"#,##0.00"</span>
</code></pre>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2.2 货币格式</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在数值前添加货币符号，通常配合千分位与小数位使用。</span></p>
<figure class="figure-table" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch"><table style="box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 0; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224, 224, 224, 1); color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">€ 1,234.56</span></td></tr></tbody></table></figure>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">代码示例：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"D4"</span>].NumberValue = <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">9999.99</span>
sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"D4"</span>].NumberFormat = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"¥#,##0.00"</span>
</code></pre>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2.3 百分比格式</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">将小数乘以 100 后以百分比形式展示。</span></p>

<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2.5 科学计数法</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">适用于极大或极小数值的紧凑展示。</span></p>
<figure class="figure-table" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch"><table style="box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; <h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2.6 分数格式</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">以分数形式显示小数。</span></p>
<figure class="figure-table" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch"><table style="box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 15px; margin: 0"><thead style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><th style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; text-align: left; margin: 0">原始值</span></th><th style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); background: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">显示效果</span></th></tr></thead><tbody style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224, 224, 224, 1); color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"># ?/?</code></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224, 224, 224, 1); color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0.75</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224, 224, 224, 1); color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">3/4</span></td></tr><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1)"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224, 224, 224, 1); color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"># ??/??</code></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224, 224, 224, 1); color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0.333</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224, 224, 224, 1); color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1/3</span></td></tr></tbody></table></figure>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2.7 条件颜色格式</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">根据数值正负自动显示不同颜色，方括号内指定颜色名称。</span></p>
<figure class="figure-table" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch"><table style="box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 15px; margin: 0"><thead style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><th style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); background: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">格式代码</span></th><th style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); background: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">原始值</span></th><th style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); background: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">显示效果</span></th></tr></thead><tbody style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224, 224, 224, 1); color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">[Green]#,##0;[Red]-#,##0</code></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224, 224, 224, 1); color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">正数绿色，负数红色</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224, 224, 224, 1); color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"></td></tr><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1)"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224, 224, 224, 1); color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">[Red]#,##0.00</code></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224, 224, 224, 1); color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">全部显示为红色</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224, 224, 224, 1); color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"></td></tr></tbody></table></figure>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">代码示例：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"D12"</span>].NumberValue = -<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1234.56</span>
sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"D12"</span>].NumberFormat = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"[Green]#,##0.00;[Red]-#,##0.00"</span>
</code></pre>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2.8 自定义文本前缀/后缀</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在数值前后附加固定文本，同时保持数值可计算性。文本需用双引号包裹。</span></p>
<figure class="figure-table" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch"><table style="box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 15px; margin: 0"><thead style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><th style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); background: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">格式代码</span></th><th style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); background: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">原始值</span></th><th style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); background: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">显示效果</span></th></tr></thead><tbody style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224, 224, 224, 1); color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">"合计："#,##0" 元"</code></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224, 224, 224, 1); color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">5000</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224, 224, 224, 1); color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">合计：5,000 元</span></td></tr><tr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1)"><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224, 224, 224, 1); color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">0" 件"</code></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224, 224, 224, 1); color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">120</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224, 224, 224, 1); color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">120 件</span></td></tr></tbody></table></figure>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">三、完整示例代码</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">以下示例在同一张工作表中集中演示多种数字格式效果：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(141, 134, 135, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 创建工作簿</span><br>
workbook = Workbook()<br>
sheet = workbook.Worksheets.get_Item(<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>)<br>
sheet.Name = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"数字格式示例"</span></p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(141, 134, 135, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 设置列宽</span><br>
sheet.SetColumnWidth(<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">22</span>)<br>
sheet.SetColumnWidth(<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">3</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">15</span>)<br>
sheet.SetColumnWidth(<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">4</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">20</span>)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(141, 134, 135, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 表头</span><br>
sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"B2"</span>].Text = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"格式说明"</span><br>
sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"C2"</span>].Text = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"原始值"</span><br>
sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"D2"</span>].Text = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"显示结果"</span><br>
header_style = sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"B2:D2"</span>].Style<br>
header_style.Font.IsBold = <span class="hljs-literal" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">True</span><br>
header_style.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignType.Center</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(141, 134, 135, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 示例数据与格式</span><br>
examples = [<br>
(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"两位小数"</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1234.567</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"0.00"</span>),<br>
(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"千分位分隔"</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1234567.89</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"#,##0.00"</span>),<br>
(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"人民币货币"</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">9999.99</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"¥#,##0.00"</span>),<br>
(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"美元货币"</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">9999.99</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"$#,##0.00"</span>),<br>
(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"百分比两位"</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0.12345</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"0.00%"</span>),<br>
(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"日期格式"</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">45566</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"yyyy-mm-dd"</span>),<br>
(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"时间格式"</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0.625</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"hh:mm:ss"</span>),<br>
(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"科学计数法"</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1234567</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"0.00E+00"</span>),<br>
(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"正负分色"</span>, -<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1234.56</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"[Green]#,##0.00;[Red]-#,##0.00"</span>),<br>
(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"文本前缀"</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">5000</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">'"合计："#,##0" 元"'</span>),<br>
]</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(141, 134, 135, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 逐行写入</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> i, (desc, value, fmt) <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(129, 91, 164, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">enumerate</span>(examples, start=<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(249, 155, 21, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">3</span>):<br>
sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">f"B<span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{i}</span>"</span>].Text = desc<br>
sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">f"C<span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{i}</span>"</span>].NumberValue = value<br>
sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">f"C<span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{i}</span>"</span>].NumberFormat = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"General"</span><br>
sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">f"D<span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{i}</span>"</span>].NumberValue = value<br>
sheet.Range[<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">f"D<span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{i}</span>"</span>].NumberFormat = fmt</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(141, 134, 135, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 自动调整列宽</span><br>
sheet.AllocatedRange.AutoFitColumns()</p>
</code><p><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(141, 134, 135, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 保存文件</span><br>
workbook.SaveToFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(72, 182, 133, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"number_format_demo.xlsx"</span>, ExcelVersion.Version2016)<br>
workbook.Dispose()<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">运行后将生成 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">number_format_demo.xlsx</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 文件，C 列为原始通用格式数值，D 列为应用格式后的显示效果。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">四、格式代码语法规则</span></h2>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">4.1 占位符含义</span></h3>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 8px 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">0</code></strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：数字占位符。若对应位无数字则显示 0，强制补位。</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">#</code></strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：数字占位符。若对应位无数字则不显示，不补零。</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">?</code></strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：数字占位符。用于对齐分数的小数点。</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">.</code></strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：小数点位置标记。</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">,</code></strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">：千分位分隔符，或数值缩放（末尾逗号表示除以 1000）。</span></li>
</ul>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">4.2 分段规则</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">格式代码最多分为四段，以分号分隔：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">正数格式;负数格式;零值格式;文本格式
</code></pre>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 8px 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">只写一段：应用于所有数值</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">写两段：第一段用于正数和零，第二段用于负数</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">写三段：分别对应正、负、零</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">写四段：增加文本格式规则</span></li>
</ul>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">示例：</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">#,##0.00;[Red]-#,##0.00;"-";@</code></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">含义：正数正常显示千分位两位小数；负数红色并带负号；零值显示为短横线；文本保持原样。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">五、注意事项与常见问题</span></h2>
<ol style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 8px 0; padding-left: 20px; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); list-style-type: decimal">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all; margin: 6px 0"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">数值类型必须正确</strong></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all; margin: 6px 0"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">只有通过 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">NumberValue</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 写入的数值才能应用数字格式。若使用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Text</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 属性写入字符串形式的数字，格式代码不会生效。</span></p>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all; margin: 6px 0"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">格式代码区分区域设置</strong></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all; margin: 6px 0"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">部分格式符号（如千分位、日期分隔符）受系统区域设置影响。跨地区使用时建议采用标准格式代码。</span></p>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all; margin: 6px 0"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">日期序列值基准</strong></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all; margin: 6px 0"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Excel 默认以 1900-01-01 为序列值 1。设置日期格式前需确认数值对应的日期是否正确。</span></p>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all; margin: 6px 0"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">免费版限制</strong></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all; margin: 6px 0"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Free 版本存在工作表数量与行数限制，适用于小型文件处理场景。大规模数据处理需评估是否满足业务需求。</span></p>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all; margin: 6px 0"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">格式继承与覆盖</strong></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all; margin: 6px 0"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">单元格级别的 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">NumberFormat</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 设置会覆盖列或行级别的默认格式。批量设置时，可对整个 Range 统一赋值以提升效率。</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">六、总结</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 0; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">通过 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">NumberFormat</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 属性配合格式代码，可以在 Python 中精确控制 Excel 单元格的数值显示效果。掌握常用格式代码与分段规则后，即可实现货币、百分比、日期、条件颜色等多种专业展示效果，满足报表自动化的各类排版需求。在实际项目中，建议将常用格式封装为常量或配置项，以提升代码的可维护性与复用性。</span></p></section>

</div>
